job.title: Digital Project Delivery Lead
job.description:
We’re Hiring: Digital Project Delivery Lead 🚀

📍 Location: Dublin, Ireland

💼 Type: Permanent

📈 Reports To: Chief Operating Officer


About the Role

Are you a practical construction troubleshooter who knows how sites actually run?

We are a vertically integrated residential developer-builder with a large pipeline of active schemes across Ireland. We’re looking for a Digital Project Delivery Lead to fill an unusual, high-impact dual mandate: solve real operational friction on live sites, and turn those solutions into software.

You’ll sit at the intersection of live construction site operations and product engineering—embedding alongside QSs, construction managers, and site leads to fix bottlenecks, while translating those hard-won learnings into structured requirements for an affiliated AI/proptech engineering team.

Responsibilities:

  • 🛠️ Troubleshoot on Site: Embed into live residential schemes to identify and fix high-cost, high-friction operational bottlenecks from tender through to handover.
  • 🌉 Bridge Operations & Tech: Translate real-world construction challenges into structured workflows and product requirements for software/AI engineering teams.
  • 🤖 Drive AI Adoption: Roll out in-house digital and AI tools directly into site workflows, measuring success by actual productivity gains—not just tool deployment.
  • 📊 Deliver Clear Insights: Surface data-driven insights that give site leads and executive management clear visibility on time and cost metrics.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in construction delivery, digital construction, or project controls (residential or large-scale build experience preferred).
  • A proven track record of stepping onto a live site, diagnosing operational friction, and fixing it fast.
  • Ability to speak both "site" and "software"—translating messy site realities into clear product specs.
  • Deep familiarity with standard construction stacks: BIM/CDE (ISO 19650), ACC, Asta Powerproject, CostX, and Power BI.
  • Practical understanding of the Irish construction market and delivery environment.

Why Join?

  • Direct Impact: See your site fixes directly hit the P&L and shape next-generation construction tech.
  • Flexibility: A fractional arrangement that can adapt to fit around your commitments as the platform scales.
  • Cutting-Edge Stack: Work directly at the intersection of live developer-builder operations and agentic AI.

job.title: Senior Process Development Manager
job.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Senior Process Development Manager to join a rapidly growing and highly innovative medical device organisation. This is a key leadership role, offering the opportunity to build and develop high-performing engineering teams while driving strategic process development initiatives that support the manufacture of life-changing technologies.

The Role

Reporting into senior leadership, you will provide both technical and people leadership across the Process Development function. You will be responsible for delivering robust manufacturing processes, improving yields, supporting new product introductions, and developing the capability of a talented engineering team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Process Development team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Define and execute the strategic direction for Process Development in line with business objectives.
  • Drive complex process development projects from concept through implementation and manufacturing transfer.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve process capability, manufacturing efficiency, scalability and product yield.
  • Lead technical problem-solving activities, root cause investigations and process optimisation initiatives using data-driven methodologies.
  • Manage multiple cross-functional projects, ensuring delivery against timelines, quality standards and business objectives.
  • Develop project plans, budgets, resource requirements and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver technical and operational improvements.
  • Champion continuous improvement methodologies and best engineering practices.
  • Ensure compliance with quality systems, regulatory requirements and health & safety standards.
  • Support process validation, manufacturing readiness and design transfer activities.
  • Manage departmental budgets and support strategic resource planning.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related discipline (Manufacturing, Biomedical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or similar).
  • 8-10+ years' experience within a regulated manufacturing or medical device environment.
  • 3-5+ years' experience leading engineering, manufacturing or process development teams.
  • Proven success delivering complex process improvement, yield improvement and operational excellence projects.
  • Strong people management experience with a track record of coaching and developing engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organisational change and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to deliver multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical, technical problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

What's on Offer

  • Opportunity to join a high-growth medical technology company developing innovative healthcare solutions.
  • A strategic leadership position with significant influence across the organisation.
  • The chance to lead talented engineering teams and shape future manufacturing capability.
  • A collaborative, innovation-driven environment focused on continuous improvement.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

job.title: Senior Process Development Engineer

  • Market access, pricing and reimbursement, applications to the HSE under the Health (Pricing and Supply of Medical Goods) Act 2013 to gain reimbursement status for medicines, medical devices, special dietary foods etc and on responding to the HSE in respect of price reviews, pricing strategies of the HSE Medicines Management Programme and other pricing initiatives and requests for price reductions. Advising on the IPHA and MFI Framework Agreements for the Supply of Medicines to the HSE.
  • Responding to regulatory authorities, conformity assessment bodies, and governmental authorities including HPRA, HIQA, Department of Health and the HSE in respect of adverse findings on inspection, audit and in respect of reviews, inquiries and investigations.
  • Irish medical and healthcare law, telemedicine, digital health, and cross border healthcare.
  • Work closely with the firm’s corporate teams advising clients on the establishment of operations in Ireland and on the regulatory aspects of structuring and due diligence in corporate transactions in the regulated sectors supported by the Healthcare and Life Sciences team
  • On the contentious side the successful candidate will represent manufacturers and producers in the defence of product liability claims.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
A growing cardiovascular medical device company based in Galway is seeking a Quality Engineer to join its expanding team on a 6-month contract.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, venture-backed medical device company where you will work closely with Engineering, R&D and Manufacturing to ensure product quality and regulatory compliance throughout product development and manufacturing.

The Quality Engineer will have the opportunity to contribute to the QMS, design quality activities, manufacturing support and supplier quality within an ISO 13485 regulated environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with R&D, Manufacturing and Engineering teams to ensure quality requirements are integrated throughout product development and manufacturing.
  • Support design control activities including design reviews, design verification and validation documentation, and design change management.
  • Participate in risk management activities including Design FMEA, Process FMEA and risk assessments.
  • Review and approve quality documentation including protocols, reports, procedures and engineering changes.
  • Investigate non-conformances, customer complaints and quality issues, supporting root cause analysis and CAPA implementation.
  • Support internal, supplier and external audit activities and assist in maintaining audit readiness.
  • Assist with supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, monitoring and performance reviews.
  • Support process validation and equipment qualification activities, ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor quality metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Participate in document control, training and change management activities.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA Quality System Regulation, EU MDR and other applicable regulatory standards.

Qualifications & Requirements Experience:

  • Degree in Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 3 years of quality engineering experience within the medical device industry.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 13485 and medical device quality systems.
  • Experience supporting Design Controls and Design Quality activities.
  • Experience with CAPA, non-conformance investigations and root cause analysis.
  • Experience supporting internal and external audits.
  • Understanding of FDA Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820) and EU Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR).
  • Excellent documentation, communication and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Previous experience within Class III, cardiovascular or catheter-based medical devices would be an advantage.
  • Experience working in a start-up or early-stage medical device company would be highly desirable.

This is a 6 month contract based in Galway City.

job.title: Funds Professional Support Lawyer
job.description:

Our client a top tier firm is seeking to recruit a Professional Support Lawyer to join its Tier 1 Asset Management and Investment Funds (AMIF) department.

Responsibilities:

  • To keep fee earners in the AMIF group up to speed on legal and regulatory developments, including pipeline developments.
  • To assist AMIF fee earners in respect of technical and/or practical legal issues raised by clients, and to assist in the development of practice notes, toolkits and other legal know how.

  • To capture and disseminate relevant legal knowledge to ensure that the collective expertise and knowledge of the AMIF group is supported, increased, understood, and shared.

• Strong technical, legal and analytical skills.
